cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

mechanism: A diagnoses a cold room as the only capable heater user, patiently separating timer settings from heat until B must request actual intervention.
confusable: Holding a locked fuse cupboard as leverage is power over access, not S03 professional correction of mistakes.
comparison: Cupboard alternative uses shared physical assembly; this one turns a claimed simple instruction request into admitted diagnostic help.
seedUse: Heater seed supplies resisting help while accepting a blanket; change the locked-access mechanism to actual device-operation errors.
